design_philosophy: Aureum Noir. A high-end editorial canvas for a technical IoT product. The UI mimics a high-end luxury dashboard with precise biometric readouts. We fuse luxury fashion aesthetics (deep blacks, gold accents, crisp editorial fonts) with elite performance interfaces (cyber-cyan neon markers, dense data displays).

typography.installation: Add Google Fonts imports for Outfit, Manrope, and JetBrains Mono.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10' for dashboard sidebar, floating map controls, and pricing cards. Never use pure transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Replace traditional drop shadows with inner glows and subtle colored drop-shadows (e.g., drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.4)] for active pet markers).
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Apply a moving gradient border effect for the 'Pro' pricing tier card to make it feel premium and active.

marketing_features.strategy: The Tetris Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
marketing_features.items: Feature 1 (Live Map) spans 8 cols. Feature 2 (Biometrics) spans 4 cols. Feature 3 (Geofence) spans full width 12 cols. Use generous padding (p-12) inside these feature cards.

dashboard.strategy: High Density Technical Grid. Cardless aesthetics where possible, relying on 1px subtle borders.
dashboard.structure: Sidebar (w-72 fixed, glassmorphic) + Main Content (flex-1 relative).
dashboard.map_area: Full bleed absolute map underneath, with floating glassmorphic widgets (Health Stats, Geofence Controls) positioned absolute bottom and right.

components_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use #D4AF37 background with black text. Hover state must lift slightly (-translate-y-0.5) and increase brightness.
components_strategy.map: Leaflet JS. MUST use CartoDB Dark Matter tile layer ('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png') to maintain the luxury dark mode aesthetic. Standard openstreetmap tiles will ruin the design.
components_strategy.pet_marker: Custom SVG wrapped in a Framer Motion div that pulses (scale 1 to 1.5, opacity 0.8 to 0) with 'tech_cyan' to represent live WebSocket GPS updates.
components_strategy.health_stats_card: Floating glass panel on the dashboard. Use 'biometric_red' for a pulsing heart icon next to BPM data.
components_strategy.geofence_slider: Shadcn Slider customized. The track should be dark gray, the active fill and thumb should be 'tech_cyan'.
components_strategy.icons: Use 'lucide-react' with a consistent stroke-width of 1.5 for a delicate, premium feel.

motion.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight upward translation (y: 20 -> 0) over 0.6s using Framer Motion.
motion.live_data: Real-time stats should have a color-flash effect (e.g., flash cyan briefly) when the WebSocket pushes new data.
motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must transition smoothly (duration-300 ease-out).

hero_background.description: Elegant black dog portrait on dark background. Use with a linear gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-black/80 to-black/30) so text remains highly readable.

pet_avatar_1.description: Macro photography of black cat with green eyes. Use for the dashboard pet list avatar.

abstract_map_bg.description: Abstract topographic lines. Use as a subtle background pattern for the 'Live Tracking' feature card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use generic 'Inter' or 'Roboto' for headings. Stick to 'Outfit'.
Never center-align large blocks of text; left-align for high-end editorial feel.
Implement actual WebSocket simulations for the Map marker and heartbeat (BPM) stats on the dashboard.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and key text fields.
Use standard Tailwind CSS classes. For glass effects, use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5'.
Ensure Leaflet Map uses the CartoDB Dark Matter tile layer for the premium aesthetic. DO NOT use standard light OSM maps.
Do not use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or floating headers.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties like transform and opacity.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
